description: Source code for the GitRepository class managing Git operations within the Thingsboard project, including cloning, fetching, commits, diffs, and authentication handling.

classes.name: GitRepository
classes.description: Main class managing Git operations such as clone, fetch, commit, push, diff, and branch management within the project.

classes.name: Commit
classes.description: Data class representing a Git commit with timestamp, id, message, author name, and email.

classes.name: Status
classes.description: Data class representing the status of a repository including added, modified, and removed files.

classes.name: Diff
classes.description: Data class representing differences between commits, including file path, change type, file contents at commits, and diff string.

classes.name: RepoFile
classes.description: Record representing a file in the repository with path, name, and type (file or directory).

classes.name: FileType
classes.description: Enum for file types: FILE or DIRECTORY.

classes.name: CommitFilter
classes.description: RevFilter implementation for filtering commits based on search text and merge commit visibility.

classes.name: AuthHandler
classes.description: Helper class for managing authentication credentials and SSH session factory for Git operations.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Initializes a new Git repository in the specified directory.

methods.name: clone
methods.description: Clones a remote repository into a local directory.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Opens an existing Git repository from a directory.

methods.name: openOrClone
methods.description: Opens an existing repository or clones it if not present, with optional fetch.

methods.name: test
methods.description: Tests connectivity and basic operations with a remote repository.

methods.name: fetch
methods.description: Fetches updates from the remote repository.

methods.name: deleteLocalBranchIfExists
methods.description: Deletes a local branch if it exists.

methods.name: resetAndClean
methods.description: Resets the repository to a clean state, discarding local changes.

methods.name: merge
methods.description: Merges a specified branch into the current branch.

methods.name: listBranches
methods.description: Lists all branches in the repository.

methods.name: listCommits
methods.description: Lists commits on a branch with pagination and optional path filtering.

methods.name: listFilesAtCommit
methods.description: Lists files at a specific commit and path.

methods.name: getFileContentAtCommit
methods.description: Retrieves file content at a specific commit.

methods.name: createAndCheckoutOrphanBranch
methods.description: Creates and checks out an orphan branch.

methods.name: checkoutBranch
methods.description: Checks out a branch.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds files matching a pattern to the index.

methods.name: status
methods.description: Gets the current status of the repository.

methods.name: commit
methods.description: Creates a new commit with a message and author info.

methods.name: push
methods.description: Pushes local changes to the remote repository.

methods.name: getContentsDiff
methods.description: Generates a diff string between two file contents.

methods.name: getDiffList
methods.description: Generates a list of diffs between two commits for a specific path.
